The envelope is now staged to $WORK/envelope.txt and read with jq --rawfile instead of passed through argv, plus a FRAME-GUARD block asserting $CALL is non-empty and re-parses as JSON before send_frame. Confirmed end-to-end by the second paid relay attempt, which DELIVERED the 1.6MB request to gpt-5.6-sol — something the pre-fix driver could not do at all. Unadvertised bonus found by QA: --arg previously exposed the entire change-set diff in the process argument list (ps auxww); the fix removes that. Ships with C6/C7 + META in specs/codex-review.sh, where C6 self-calibrates off getconf ARG_MAX so it cannot go vacuous on a roomier host. NOTE: that relay still produced no artifact — Sol's output failed schema validation twice — but for an unrelated reason tracked as fkm.1.14, which is now the remaining blocker on ever getting a paid Sol artifact for this arc.
